one private newly created child Job, no old-PID attachment, no parent/kernel counters added as child work

identity_binding: never reopen/kill by bare PID; operate held handles/private Job and creation identity; verify image and membership before resume
acceptable_unknowns: process-owned accounting differs from physical or causal disk work
lost/unavailable terminal memory snapshot, event losses or handle query failures => explicit incomplete

durability_bridge_gap: R43 events and detailed fired points are memory-only; main writes aggregate counters, late witnesses/results. External process aggregate cannot reconstruct C_main owner or primary markers; separate driver bridge request registered
observer_failure_policy: preserve previously confirmed own witness prefix, kill-on-close containment where applicable; never infer child PASS from surviving files or CPU/time counters
owner_and_level_rules: at each chosen instrumentation level a record has one owner; source imports/loader and native work without a reliable owner marker remainC_unknown/shared, not guessedSUT or harness
adapter nesting such as fstat facade calling SyntheticPath.stat produces nested Python/model entries; logical-request count needs explicit parent/request identity, not a sum of all nested entries
OS process vector has no SUT/harness/evidence call-site split; no subtraction of model/API counts is permitted
observer queries occur in parent when external; child internal query costs remain in child accounting as defined by OS, with no assumed fixed IO-manager cost
child_process_coverage: driver direct child-creation calls0 under frozen source. Private Job covers its documented members; broker/service-created out-of-job work is not proved absent by active limit alone. Runtime closure and separate authorization remain required; unknown child activity is not0.
